events.title: Graduation Day
events.what_happens: the academy graduation at Elysian Park. Your family sits in the stands in a form set by your origin; your four classmates are in line beside you. A licensed hero flies over uninvited and the cameras turn to him instead of you.
events.branches: who you stand with for the class photo; whether you walk over to Corey Banks, the washout watching from the fence.
events.consequences: starting approval with each classmate; corey_snubbed or corey_kind.

events.title: Reporting to Rampart
events.what_happens: Peg checks you in at the front desk, you find your locker next to Ducks's, and you see Hartley's retirement countdown calendar.
events.branches: respectful, nervous or cocky with Peg; ask why the division left Temple Street.
events.consequences: Peg's starting attitude; asking about Temple Street sets asked_temple_st and makes Peg remember you (needed for MS-17).

events.title: Meeting Your FTO
events.trigger: first day; your FTO comes from academy record plus background.
events.what_happens: Ortega says nothing and watches how you check the car; Whitfield is adjusting a small camera in his sun visor; Arakawa has a betting slip on the dashboard and covers it with a clipboard.
events.branches: answer the FTO's first question ("Why are you here?") honestly or with what you think they want.
events.consequences: FTO approval baseline; noticing the slip (Perception) sets saw_arakawa_slip.

events.title: First Roll Call
events.what_happens: Sgt. Moreland reads crime trends, a cape alert (Solstice appearing in Hollywood) and a BOLO for a gray Civic. Ducks has written "BOOT" next to your name on the board.
events.branches: laugh, fire back, or ignore it.
events.consequences: squad reputation; the gray Civic appears during the shift, and players who listened get a free stop.

events.title: The Kit Room
events.what_happens: Lenny asks what you need and watches whether you inspect what he hands you.
events.branches: check the Taser cartridges and shotgun properly, sign without looking, or flatter him.
events.consequences: gear quality tier for Act 1; Lenny approval.

events.title: The Back Seat
events.what_happens: under the rear seat is a baggie of Spark left by the previous shift, Calloway's crew.
events.branches: book it as found property, tell your FTO, toss it, or pocket it; or skip the check entirely.
events.consequences: booking it sets calloway_noticed_you; pocketing sets the secret pocketed_spark; skipping the check sets skipped_car_check, which later lets a suspect's contraband turn up in your car (SC-12 variant).

events.title: The First Call
events.what_happens: a 415 noise complaint in Westlake turns out to be a TV left on in the apartment of an elderly woman who has been dead for days. The smell; the neighbor who never knocked.
events.branches: let your FTO lead, take the lead yourself, or handle the neighbor's guilt. Iron Stomach or a Nerve check decides whether you vomit in the hallway.
events.consequences: first minor trauma point; the death report tutorial; first_body.

events.title: First Code 7
events.what_happens: a taco truck on Alvarado. Your FTO explains their philosophy of the job; from the curb you can see the fences of the Hole three blocks south.
events.branches: ask about the Hole, ask about the FTO, or eat in silence.
events.consequences: the Hole appears on your map; Code 7 spot unlocked; FTO approval.

events.title: The First Report
events.what_happens: the report-writing tutorial on the dead woman. Your FTO returns it covered in red ink.
events.branches: rewrite it carefully, argue, or copy your FTO's phrasing exactly.
events.consequences: Report Writing practice; copying sets a mild parrot tag that defense attorneys can exploit later.

events.title: First Foot Pursuit
events.trigger: first two weeks, first suspect who runs.
events.what_happens: a 10851 suspect bails from a stolen car into Pico-Union backyards.
events.branches: chase alone into a dark yard, set a perimeter, or call the airship.
events.consequences: injury risk; the FTO's lecture either way ("Chasing alone into a yard is how cops die"); FTO evaluation.

events.title: The Wrong Shotgun
events.trigger: weeks 3 to 6, conditional on Ducks's hazing being active.
events.what_happens: Ducks has swapped the tape labels on the lethal and beanbag shotguns as a joke.
events.branches: catch it at the kit room (Perception or ST-05 diligence), miss it, or report it.
events.consequences: if missed and the beanbag is needed, a near-fatal mistake on a call, and a critical incident; Ducks's shame feeds DC-20; reporting it costs squad approval and earns Moreland's respect.

events.title: First Use-of-Force Review
events.trigger: first time you go hands-on or use a Taser.
events.what_happens: a sergeant reviews the incident while Whitlow hovers nearby.
events.branches: give a straight account, minimize, or ask for Whitlow first.
events.consequences: Credibility; Whitlow relationship; the incident enters your file.

events.title: Mid-Training Evaluation
events.what_happens: your FTO and Moreland review your performance.
events.branches: accept criticism, push back, or appeal to Benning.
events.consequences: skill points; a poor result extends training by four weeks; a strong result gives you more call choice early.

events.title: The Shooting Review
events.what_happens: you're separated from your partner, your gun is taken for evidence, Whitlow arrives, Force Investigation Division interviews you, and you're booked with Dr. Moss and sent home for 72 hours.
events.branches: talk before the interview, wait for your rep, or call home.
events.consequences: major trauma; Credibility from consistency with your later report; ois_count +1; mandatory PL-20 session.

events.title: The Ride-Along
events.what_happens: Lt. Benning assigns a ride-along: Rachel Kim from the accountability cape network.
events.branches: cooperate, stonewall, or show her something real.
events.consequences: Media reputation; first meeting with Rachel (romance stage Acquaintance); Benning watches how you handle press.

events.title: Cutting the Cord
events.what_happens: your last shift with your FTO. They say what they really think of you; the variant depends on approval and what you know about their secret.
events.branches: thank them, confront them, or say nothing.
events.consequences: the FTO's final rating; new partner assignment for final probation; FTO relationship locks in for Act 3.

events.title: Probation Ends
events.what_happens: the day you become Police Officer II, or the day you don't.
events.branches: determined by your ending route.
events.consequences: final career state feeding the ending (MS-31).

events.title: The Burn Mark
events.what_happens: a Spark overdose at the edge of the Hole. The victim, a teenager named Beto, has blistered palms in a spiral pattern no drug produces.
events.branches: note the burns in your report, mention them to your FTO, photograph them, or ignore them; a First Aid check decides whether he lives to reach County.
events.consequences: clue burn_mark; if Beto lives, he vanishes from the hospital two days later (feeds MS-05).

events.title: Trucks on Bonnie Brae
events.trigger: Act 1, overnight watch, fixed date one night before MS-08's rehearsal fight (a small Act 1 skirmish).
events.what_happens: three Restora Group trucks parked on a residential street with crews asleep in the cabs. The next afternoon a minor cape fight wrecks that block.
events.branches: field interview the crew, run the plates, or drive past.
events.consequences: clue restora_trucks; a field interview card puts your name in Restora's files, and Castellan knows it by MS-09.

events.title: Not Their Call
events.trigger: Act 1, a domestic call inside the Hole.
events.what_happens: Calloway's gang crew arrives uninvited and takes over the scene, and a squatter is taken away in their car instead of to booking.
events.branches: object, defer, ask your FTO, or note the car number.
events.consequences: clue calloway_hole; Calloway's opinion of you (objecting lowers it, deferring raises it).

events.title: Slow Roll
events.trigger: Act 1, conditional on FTO Arakawa; other FTOs get a variant where a different unit is slow.
events.what_happens: a debris call after a fight. Arakawa takes the long way and stops for coffee. When you arrive, federal agents have already cleared the scene.
events.branches: notice the delay (Perception), say something, or let it go.
events.consequences: clue slow_roll; speaking up lowers Arakawa's approval and raises yours with Ani if you tell her.

events.title: The Report Nobody Works
events.trigger: Act 1, after MS-01, or a random mother from the Hole if Beto died.
events.what_happens: Beto's mother comes to the front desk to report him missing; the desk officer calls him a runaway.
events.branches: take a full report, take a minimal one, refer her to Father Tomás, or call County yourself.
events.consequences: clue missing_beto; full report unlocks the missing-persons thread early in Act 2; Community reputation in MacArthur Park.

events.title: Early Odds
events.trigger: Act 1, optional, Kramer's pool board in the break room.
events.what_happens: Kramer's pool already lists odds on a fight "over Westlake" a week before it happens.
events.branches: ask Kramer, bet, photograph the board, or ignore it.
events.consequences: clue early_odds; betting adds a debt to Kramer and a small secret.

events.title: Héctor Ruiz
events.trigger: Act 1, fixed, 415 at a Westlake building.
events.what_happens: a confrontation between tenants and Restora's eviction crew. Héctor Ruiz, the organizer, is loud, funny and stubborn. Restora's papers are legal.
events.branches: enforce the writ, mediate, quietly tell Héctor his rights, or take his flyer.
events.consequences: met_hector and his opinion of you; Restora's opinion; this decides how much his death in MS-08 hurts.

events.title: The 6th Street Fight
events.trigger: Act 1 climax, fixed (around week 16), during your shift.
events.what_happens: Solstice fights a "villain" called Breakwater above Westlake. Disaster footage: falling glass, a collapsing facade, screaming. You evacuate and triage under Critical Time. You can see Breakwater pull his punches, Castellan staffers arriving with a statement before the dust settles, and agents loading two uninjured people from the Hole into an unmarked van. Héctor dies under the facade.
events.branches: who you save first (triage); what you notice (Perception and Power Assessment); whether you confront the agents; whether you reach Héctor before he dies.
events.consequences: major trauma; memory cards for MS-09; clues pulled_punch, castellan_early, van_at_6th; hector_last_words if you reached him.

events.title: The Statement
events.what_happens: a friendly Castellan representative brings coffee and a draft statement for the Ledger review that blames Breakwater for every death.
events.branches: sign it, refuse, rewrite it in your own words, or write your report first and say nothing.
events.consequences: Credibility; Castellan's attitude; your report sets the opening tone of Act 2 (section 9).

events.title: Unavoidable
events.trigger: one week after MS-08, fixed, at The Precinct or at home.
events.what_happens: the Ledger board rules Héctor's death "unavoidable" on TV. His widow, Lucía Ruiz, is shown outside the hearing. The squad toasts Solstice.
events.branches: drink with them, leave, or say what you saw.
events.consequences: squad reputation; Act 2 begins.

events.title: The Door In
events.trigger: Act 2 opening, conditional on your dominant playthrough style.
events.what_happens: one of five entry scenes. Hot-call chaser: Calloway invites you for a beer after a shooting. Coaster: a squatter kid named Lalo starts talking to you at your favorite Code 7 spot. Community cop: Lucía Ruiz and the tenant group come to you through Garza. Numbers cop: a stop turns up a runner carrying casualty odds on fights that haven't happened. Investigator: Szabo pulls you aside.
events.branches: accept the opening or turn it down; a declined door is replaced by the next style's within two weeks.
events.consequences: first Act 2 thread unlocked; entry_style set.

events.title: Szabo's Murder Book
events.trigger: Act 2, after MS-11 investigator entry or when you share MS-08 clues with Szabo.
events.what_happens: in a booth at a Thai Town diner, Szabo opens a binder labeled with Héctor's name and asks you to walk him through 6th Street.
events.branches: tell everything, tell some, or refuse. Your memory cards and report are compared for consistency.
events.consequences: investigation partner Szabo; Credibility check; szabo_partner.

events.title: The Paper Trail
events.trigger: Act 2, any day off after MS-12 or a tip from Rachel or Joe.
events.what_happens: at the county recorder's office, you find shell companies buying blocks a month before each fight, every one tracing back to Restora.
events.branches: copy the records, photograph them, or ask a clerk who else has been looking.
events.consequences: evidence restora_shells; the clerk mentions a man in a suit asking the same thing (Hollis); costs a day off and a missed personal event.

events.title: The Runner's Sheet
events.trigger: Act 2, numbers-cop entry or a later traffic stop.
events.what_happens: a runner for Sarkisian carries a sheet with odds on casualty counts for named dates.
events.branches: book the sheet as evidence (it goes to Calloway's unit), keep a copy, flip the runner, or let him go for a favor.
events.consequences: evidence odds_sheet; Sarkisian learns your name if booked; flipping him creates the informant Toro.

events.title: Whitfield's Tapes
events.trigger: Act 2, Whitfield approval high or you saw his camera (ST-03).
events.what_happens: in Whitfield's garage, years of visor footage: the same "villains" losing to Solstice in the same poor blocks.
events.branches: ask for copies, ask him to go public, or warn him to stop recording.
events.consequences: evidence fight_pattern; sets up DC-05 and MS-22.

events.title: The Kid in the Hole
events.trigger: Act 2, coaster entry or after MS-05.
events.what_happens: Lalo, about 12, tells you about the "white van people" who come after every fight and take kids who "got sick." He knew Beto.
events.branches: believe him, give him your number, call Children and Family Services, or bring him to Father Tomás.
events.consequences: the missing-persons thread opens; Lalo becomes a protected NPC whose fate is decided in MS-29; calling CFS puts him in the system the agency watches.

events.title: Peg's Story
events.trigger: Act 2, asked_temple_st or Peg approval high, and you ask the right question.
events.what_happens: after her shift, Peg tells you about 1998: Temple Street, an off-the-books squad, the night the Hole was leveled, and a 16-year-old who died in their custody. Ortega was on that squad.
events.branches: thank her, ask for names, or promise to keep it quiet.
events.consequences: clue temple_1998; the past thread opens; Peg is now at risk if you're careless.

events.title: Hollis Buys Lunch
events.trigger: Act 2, when two investigation threads are open.
events.what_happens: Special Agent Hollis sits down at your Code 7 table, pays for everyone's food, and talks about your career, your family and your future. He knows things he shouldn't.
events.branches: be polite, be hostile, ask about the van, or take his card.
events.consequences: Federal handlers reputation starts; hollis_card; your partner's opinion of you shifts depending on how you handle it.

events.title: Ortega's Debt
events.trigger: Act 2, after MS-17 or MS-18. If Ortega isn't your FTO, you see it from outside.
events.what_happens: Hollis calls in Ortega's old debt: evidence from the 6th Street investigation must disappear from the property room.
events.branches: help her, stop her, document it, or tell Szabo.
events.consequences: Ortega's arc fork (DC-03); evidence loss or recovery; Hollis's attitude.

events.title: Wyatt's Fall
events.trigger: Act 2, conditional on Wyatt's arc state.
events.what_happens: one of three: Wyatt overdoses on boosters in his car, is turned by Calloway into a courier, or is caught by Internal Affairs.
events.branches: save him (First Aid), report him, cover for him, or use him as a way into the crew.
events.consequences: if you covered for him earlier, IA names you too; Wyatt alive or dead affects the classmates' endings.

events.title: Arakawa Exposed
events.trigger: Act 2, conditional on saw_arakawa_slip, slow_roll or Kramer's pool collapse (DC-27).
events.what_happens: Arakawa's debt to Sarkisian and his slow responses come out, through you, through Kramer or through Sarkisian himself.
events.branches: expose him, warn him, or help him get out.
events.consequences: Arakawa fired, flipped as a witness, or dead (Sarkisian's choice if he talks).

events.title: Someone at Whitfield's House
events.trigger: Act 2, after MS-15, conditional on footage being out of Whitfield's hands or him being noticed.
events.what_happens: Whitfield calls you at 2 a.m.: there's a car outside his house and his wife is scared.
events.branches: go (off duty, alone), call it in, or tell him to call 911.
events.consequences: the footage is saved, stolen or destroyed; Whitfield's family safe or hurt; trauma if it turns violent.

events.title: Ani's Report
events.trigger: Act 2, Ani approval medium or higher.
events.what_happens: Ani has written a complaint against Calloway's crew, or against an FTO, and asks you to sign as a witness.
events.branches: sign, refuse, or ask her to wait.
events.consequences: squad reputation drops sharply if you sign; Ani's trust and romance stage; Calloway's opinion.

events.title: The Threat at Home
events.trigger: Act 2, when Federal or Calloway attention passes a threshold.
events.what_happens: someone in your personal life is targeted: a manifested sibling gets a registration audit, your child's school gets a visitor, your partner's car is broken into, or Danny's garage gets raided.
events.branches: tell them the truth, hide it, move them, or back off the case.
events.consequences: relationship Strain; backing off pauses the investigation for two weeks.

events.title: The Pico-Union Fight
events.trigger: Act 2 climax, fixed, but you learn of it in advance if you hold two of odds_sheet, restora_shells, fight_pattern.
events.what_happens: another staged fight is scheduled over Pico-Union.
events.branches: stop it (evacuate the block early, which tips off the conspiracy), document it (be there with a camera and witnesses), or stay away.
events.consequences: casualties, evidence, and which faction now knows you're a threat; Act 3 begins.

events.title: The Hero's Front
events.trigger: Act 3, when you move against Solstice.
events.what_happens: Benning stonewalls; arresting a superhuman needs suppression gear and federal cooperation; Castellan floods the media.
events.branches: go through command, go to Rachel, go to a federal prosecutor, or bait Solstice into a filmed confession.
events.consequences: Solstice exposed, protected, or turned on his partners.

events.title: Blue Wall
events.trigger: Act 3, Calloway's opinion low and he knows you know.
events.what_happens: you call "officer needs help" and backup is slow. Then a fake call sends you into an ambush.
events.branches: fight, hold, call Nine directly, or go to Whitlow.
events.consequences: possible death (End of Watch); exposes the crew if you survive with evidence.

events.title: Hollis's Offer
events.what_happens: at Griffith Observatory at night, Hollis lays out the truth about the sorting events and offers you a place: a federal badge, protection for your family, silence.
events.branches: accept, refuse, accept as a mole, or record him.
events.consequences: the Recruit ending opens or closes; refusing raises the threat level on MS-24 targets.

events.title: The Bulldozers
events.what_happens: Restora's crews arrive to clear the Hole, with Calloway's crew as security. Lalo and the squatters have nowhere to go.
events.branches: enforce the order, stall it, get the press there, or get the people out first.
events.consequences: Lalo safe, taken, or lost; Community reputation; final Restora outcome.

events.title: The Facility
events.trigger: Act 3, optional, Recruit or Whistleblower route with temple_1998 and missing_beto.
events.what_happens: records lead to a federal facility in the Mojave. Beto might be inside.
events.branches: go in under Hollis's escort, go in with Szabo, or give the location to Rachel.
events.consequences: the deepest layer exposed or swallowed; Beto's fate.

events.title: Last Shift
events.what_happens: the ending plays out as a final shift built from your route: Whistleblower, Company Man, Dirty, Recruit, Partial Justice, Burned Out or End of Watch.
events.branches: small final choices within the route.
events.consequences: career ending locked.

events.title: Epilogue
events.what_happens: a series of short scenes assembled from relationship states, family safety, trauma, drinking and the fates of the cast.
events.branches: none.
events.consequences: the game ends.

events.title: Ortega: The Quiet Test
events.what_happens: she lets you make a bad decision on a car stop and only speaks afterward, in the car, in two sentences.
events.branches: argue, ask what you should have done, or say nothing.
events.consequences: Ortega approval; asking unlocks her habit retraining.

events.title: Ortega: Temple Street at 3 a.m
events.what_happens: on a quiet night she drives past the old Temple Street station and parks without a word for a full minute.
events.branches: ask, wait, or pretend not to notice.
events.consequences: ortega_temple; waiting raises approval; asking too early closes her off for a month.

events.title: Ortega: Confession or Cover
events.what_happens: you confront Ortega about 1998 in an empty roll call room.
events.branches: threaten to report her, ask her to testify, or promise to protect her.
events.consequences: Ortega becomes a witness, an enemy, or a casualty (Hollis cleans up liabilities); affects Partial Justice and Whistleblower endings.

events.title: Whitfield: The Visor Camera
events.trigger: Act 1 with Whitfield, or saw_camera from another FTO's passing mention.
events.what_happens: he explains why he records everything: a partner who died in 2003 and a report that lied about it.
events.branches: ask him to keep recording you, ask him to stop, or ask for the 2003 footage.
events.consequences: Whitfield trust; unlocks MS-15.

events.title: Whitfield: The Footage Decision
events.what_happens: Whitfield asks whether he should give everything to Rachel, to IA, or burn it and protect his family.
events.branches: advise one; offer to carry it yourself.
events.consequences: the footage's route; if you carry it, MS-22 targets you instead of him.

events.title: Arakawa: The Slip
events.what_happens: he jokes about a "hobby" and offers you a piece of a sure bet on Saturday's fight.
events.branches: take it, refuse, or ask how it's sure.
events.consequences: taking it ties you to Sarkisian's books; asking plants arakawa_sure_thing.

events.title: Arakawa: The Collector
events.what_happens: a polite man sits down at your Code 7 and tells Arakawa that Victor sends his regards.
events.branches: intervene, ignore, or run the man's plates afterward.
events.consequences: clue sarkisian_collector; Arakawa's humiliation and gratitude.

events.title: Arakawa: The Ask
events.what_happens: he asks you to lend him money or to sit on a call for twenty minutes.
events.branches: lend, refuse, report, or offer to get him to Whitlow.
events.consequences: feeds MS-21; a lent sum is gone either way.

events.title: Tiana: The Name on the Call
events.trigger: Act 1, Tiana partnered with you on a mutual-aid call.
events.what_happens: the suspect in a Pico-Union robbery is Tiana's younger brother, Marcus. She freezes.
events.branches: let her step away and handle it, cover for her, or arrest him by the book.
events.consequences: Tiana's trust; Marcus's later arc (informant, prison, or turned around); tiana_brother.

events.title: Wyatt: The Bottle in the Locker
events.what_happens: you see booster pills in Wyatt's locker; he says they're for his back.
events.branches: believe him, confront him, report him, or tell Ruben or Sam.
events.consequences: knows_wyatt; covering now implicates you in MS-20.

events.title: Ani: Her Father's Name
events.what_happens: an old-timer recognizes the name Petrosyan from the Rampart scandal and says something cruel about Ani's father.
events.branches: back her up, stay out of it, or laugh.
events.consequences: Ani approval; squad reputation; her father becomes a source for the past thread if she trusts you.

events.title: Joe: The Leak
events.trigger: Act 1 or 2, after any cape incident you worked.
events.what_happens: footage from your scene appears on a cape network. Joe sold it.
events.branches: cover for him, confront him, or report him; or ask him to leak something on purpose.
events.consequences: Joe's network access (a route for evidence); IA risk for both of you.

events.title: The First Month
events.what_happens: the class meets at The Precinct and compares FTO horror stories. A drinking game, a confession, a fight.
events.branches: who you sit with, how much you drink, what you admit.
events.consequences: classmate approval; Fatigue next shift; sets the class's tone for Act 2.

events.title: Lenny: The NDA
events.what_happens: the insurer for the hero who threw a car into Lenny offers a settlement if he signs an NDA. He asks you what to do.
events.branches: take the money, refuse, or get Elliot or a lawyer to look at it.
events.consequences: Lenny's fate; if he refuses, he becomes a witness against the hero's insurer in Act 3.

events.title: Big Earl: The Diagnosis
events.trigger: Act 1 or 2, Big Earl approval medium.
events.what_happens: you find Earl coughing blood in the garage. Cancer; he hasn't told anyone.
events.branches: keep his secret, tell Peg, or drive him to his appointments.
events.consequences: Earl's trust; your time budget.

events.title: Big Earl: The Last Car
events.what_happens: Earl's last day; he gives you the best car in the fleet and the story of the war he never talks about.
events.branches: listen, share your own (veteran backgrounds unlock a unique scene).
events.consequences: a vehicle bonus; Composure restore; his funeral later becomes a Nine meeting option (DC-19).

events.title: Peg: Your Name in the Pile
events.what_happens: Peg warns you before IA does.
events.branches: thank her, ask her to lose it (she won't), or ask who filed it.
events.consequences: Peg approval; an early warning on every later complaint.

events.title: Nine: Off the Radio
events.what_happens: after a bad call, Nine says something human over the radio, off protocol. Later she calls your phone.
events.branches: talk, flirt, or keep it professional.
events.consequences: romance stage Interest or a friendship; faster backup.

events.title: Nine: The Face
events.trigger: Act 2 or 3, at a funeral, Hartley's retirement party, or The Precinct.
events.what_happens: you finally meet Nine in person.
events.branches: recognize her by voice (Perception), introduce yourself, or miss her entirely.
events.consequences: romance can advance past Interest; missing her delays the meeting by a month.

events.title: Ducks: The Funniest Man
events.trigger: Act 1 or 2, conditional; ST-11 consequences increase his shame.
events.what_happens: Ducks's pranks get meaner, he's late twice, and he jokes about his wife leaving.
events.branches: laugh it off, ask how he's really doing, or tell Whitlow.
events.consequences: sets ducks_noticed, the only thing that opens a good outcome in DC-21.

events.title: Ducks: The Garage
events.what_happens: Ducks doesn't show up for roll call. If ducks_noticed, you know where he might be and get there in time.
events.branches: talk him down, call for help, sit with him.
events.consequences: Ducks lives and gets help, or dies; his death is a station-wide critical incident and a funeral scene.

events.title: T-Bone: The Fall Guy
events.trigger: Act 2, after a use-of-force incident involving T-Bone and you.
events.what_happens: command needs someone to blame and T-Bone is the obvious choice. You're a witness.
events.branches: testify for him, against him, or stay silent.
events.consequences: T-Bone fired or saved; the neighborhood's trust in your district; Benning's opinion.

events.title: Hartley: Three Weeks to Go
events.trigger: when Hartley's calendar reaches three weeks, fixed.
events.what_happens: Hartley takes a hot call he should have avoided because you or a classmate are in trouble.
events.branches: the call's outcome depends on your speed and choices.
events.consequences: Hartley retires, is wounded and retires broken, or dies; his retirement party is a Nine meeting option.

events.title: Reyes: The Drunk Hero
events.trigger: Act 1 or 2, Reyes approval medium, riding with her on a traffic detail.
events.what_happens: Reyes pulls over a weaving car. The driver is Halcyon's mentor, a mid-ranked hero, drunk. A Castellan lawyer is on the phone within minutes.
events.branches: book him, let him go, or call his handler.
events.consequences: Reyes's career and approval; media risk; the motors path opens if you back her.

events.title: Garza: The Truce
events.trigger: Act 2, Community reputation medium in Pico-Union.
events.what_happens: Garza is brokering a truce between two gangs before a cape-linked turf war. He needs you as a neutral face at a meeting in a church basement.
events.branches: attend in uniform, attend off duty, or refuse.
events.consequences: truce holds or fails (Pico-Union crime and tension); gang informants unlocked.

events.title: Calloway: The Recruitment
events.trigger: hot-call style or a high-profile arrest.
events.what_happens: Calloway takes you out to a steakhouse and offers a place on his crew.
events.branches: join, decline, or join to investigate.
events.consequences: the Dirty ending opens; access to layer 1; calloway_crew.

events.title: Kramer: The Pool Collapses
events.trigger: Act 2, after MS-06 or a squad bet goes wrong.
events.what_happens: IA asks about the station pool and Kramer panics.
events.branches: help him dump the records, give them to Szabo, or tell IA.
events.consequences: evidence on Arakawa and Sarkisian; Kramer's job.

events.title: Whitlow: The Union Ask
events.trigger: after any incident where your testimony could hurt another cop.
events.what_happens: Whitlow asks you to "remember it the way it's written."
events.branches: agree, refuse, or ask what he means.
events.consequences: union support in your own reviews; Credibility.

events.title: Moreland: The Audit
events.what_happens: federal monitors are reviewing stops and reports; Moreland is terrified and asks you to fix a classmate's paperwork.
events.branches: fix it honestly, backdate it, or refuse.
events.consequences: Moreland's approval; a backdated report is a time bomb for court.

events.title: Benning: The Transfer Offer
events.trigger: Act 2, after you start asking questions.
events.what_happens: Benning offers you a cushy transfer to a quiet division.
events.branches: accept (the story continues from outside; harder), decline, or ask who asked her.
events.consequences: Command reputation; an early route to Company Man.

events.title: Szabo: The Homicide Door
events.trigger: Act 3, szabo_partner and a strong case.
events.what_happens: Szabo tells you he can get you into detectives after probation, if you both survive.
events.branches: accept, decline, or ask him to take the case public now.
events.consequences: career path in the epilogue; Szabo's trust.

events.title: Miranda Goes Missing
events.what_happens: the station cat is missing and the whole station, including the hardest cops, searches the lot.
events.branches: find her (Perception) or let someone else.
events.consequences: a light scene; squad approval; Composure restore.

events.title: Moving In
events.trigger: the first off-duty block, fixed; variant by housing.
events.what_happens: Koreatown: Nate helps you carry boxes and hides his product badly. Valley studio: Hank watches from his porch and the Delgados send food upstairs. Parents' place: your old bedroom, unchanged.
events.branches: how you introduce yourself as a cop.
events.consequences: starting neighbor relationships.

events.title: The Scanner in the Kitchen
events.trigger: Act 1, worrier parent, after any shooting in Rampart makes the news.
events.what_happens: your parent has bought a police scanner and listened all night. They call six times during your shift.
events.branches: answer on shift (FTO disapproval), call back after, or ask them to turn it off.
events.consequences: parent Strain; answering costs FTO approval.

events.title: The Parent Gets Sick
events.trigger: Act 2, fixed, timed to collide with a court date or big shift.
events.what_happens: a parent is hospitalized. The variant depends on parent type: the cop parent's liver, the proud parent's stroke, the worrier's heart.
events.branches: trade shifts (costs squad favors), miss court (Credibility), or miss the hospital.
events.consequences: family relationship; money; possible regret flag missed_parent.

events.title: Your Sibling in the Holding Cell
events.what_happens: your sibling is brought into Rampart's holding tank on a drug charge. Everyone at the station knows.
events.branches: stay away, visit, ask for a favor, or make the arrest stick.
events.consequences: squad reputation; sibling relationship; a favor owed to Calloway if you ask him.

events.title: The Registration Letter
events.trigger: manifested sibling, Act 1; again in MS-24.
events.what_happens: your sibling shows you a federal letter demanding they register for assessment after the 6th Street fight.
events.branches: help them register, help them hide, or ask Hollis.
events.consequences: the sibling becomes a target for the agency or protected by you; asking Hollis puts them on his list.

events.title: The Good Sibling's Ultimatum
events.trigger: good sibling, after you miss three family events.
events.what_happens: at their kid's birthday, your sibling says you're becoming someone they don't know.
events.branches: apologize and mean it, get defensive, or leave early for a shift.
events.consequences: the family drifts or holds; your Composure-restoring visits change.

events.title: Maya's School Play
events.trigger: child option, Act 1 or 2, fixed date that always conflicts with a court subpoena.
events.what_happens: Maya is a tree in her school play.
events.branches: go to court (Credibility kept, Maya hurt), go to the play (case dismissed or warrant for your failure to appear), or ask Elliot or a prosecutor to move the date.
events.consequences: Maya's trust; court outcomes; Jess remembers.

events.title: Jess's Motion
events.trigger: child option, Act 2, if your record, drinking or missed pickups pass a threshold.
events.what_happens: Jess files to reduce your custody.
events.branches: fight it in family court (a second testimony minigame), agree to supervised weekends, or give up.
events.consequences: time with Maya; one of the strongest Composure sources gained or lost.

events.title: Chris Waits Up
events.trigger: married start, first night you come home after a shooting is on the news.
events.what_happens: Chris has been sitting at the kitchen table with the TV muted.
events.branches: tell them what happened, edit it, or say "It was fine."
events.consequences: Trust and Strain; sets the marriage's pattern.

events.title: The Anniversary
events.trigger: married start, a fixed date in Act 2.
events.what_happens: the anniversary dinner you planned collides with an overtime arrest.
events.branches: hand off the arrest (squad cost), cancel, or show up three hours late.
events.consequences: Strain; possible affair temptation flag for Chris or you.

events.title: Nate's Business
events.what_happens: Nate's pot business moves into the living room right before your sergeant drops by to return a jacket.
events.branches: hide it, tell Nate to move out, or report him.
events.consequences: roommate relationship; a career risk if found.

events.title: Mrs. Yoon's Upstairs Tenant
events.what_happens: Mrs. Yoon asks you to "talk to" the man upstairs. He's a North Korean defector who's terrified of someone.
events.branches: visit as a neighbor, run him, or tell Mrs. Yoon no.
events.consequences: early link to the Lafayette Park killing (SW-05).

events.title: Hank's War
events.trigger: Valley housing, combat veteran or trauma track high.
events.what_happens: Hank finds you on the steps at 4 a.m. and tells you about Korea without being asked.
events.branches: listen, share your own, or go inside.
events.consequences: a strong trauma recovery source; Hank's health later becomes a loss if you neglect him.

events.title: Marco's Jump-In
events.trigger: Valley housing or Delgado family met, Act 1 to 2.
events.what_happens: Marco, 15, shows up with new tattoos and a split lip. His mother asks you to save him.
events.branches: mentor him, scare him straight, pass him to Garza, or wait.
events.consequences: Marco saved, arrested by you later, or killed in a gang shooting.

events.title: Danny's Garage
events.what_happens: Danny's garage is burglarized and he calls you instead of 911. He hates that he did.
events.branches: handle it as a friend, send it through channels, or find the thief yourself off duty.
events.consequences: Danny's trust; a personal call precedent.

events.title: Danny's Arrest
events.what_happens: your squad arrests Danny for receiving stolen parts. Calloway's crew made the arrest, and Danny says it's a setup because of you.
events.branches: help him, stay out of it, or investigate the crew.
events.consequences: Danny's fate; evidence that Calloway is targeting your people.

events.title: Corey Banks Resurfaces
events.what_happens: Corey is now private security for Castellan. He buys you a drink and offers information, or warns you off.
events.branches: trust him, use him, or report him.
events.consequences: an inside source on Castellan or a leak against you, depending on ST-01.

events.title: The Old Crew's Wedding
events.what_happens: your old friends' wedding. Someone does coke in the bathroom and everyone looks at you.
events.branches: ignore it, leave, or make a scene.
events.consequences: the old crew stays or drifts away.

events.title: Nadia: Someone She Knows
events.what_happens: you bring a gunshot victim into County, and it's Nadia's cousin. He dies while you're both in the room.
events.branches: stay, give her space, or tell her what happened on the call.
events.consequences: the relationship's late-game test; Trust or a break.

events.title: The Psychologist
events.trigger: mandatory after ST-14; optional any time.
events.what_happens: sessions with Dr. Lena Moss. She asks about sleep, drinking and the moment you can't stop seeing.
events.branches: open up, give minimal answers, or lie.
events.consequences: trauma triggers weakened; a note in your file; squad stigma if it's known.

events.title: Elliot: The Cross
events.what_happens: he takes your report apart, politely, then buys you a coffee afterward.
events.branches: take it badly, laugh, or ask how he found the hole.
events.consequences: romance Acquaintance; your Report Writing improves if you listen.

events.title: Rachel: The Story
events.what_happens: Rachel's network is about to run a conspiracy story with your name as a source.
events.branches: ask her to kill it, let it run, or give her more.
events.consequences: Media reputation; Trust; the Whistleblower route accelerates or stalls.

events.title: Halcyon: The Staged Fight
events.what_happens: you realize Halcyon was paid to lose a fight in MS-25 or an earlier one.
events.branches: confront, protect, or use Halcyon as a witness.
events.consequences: Halcyon's arc: testimony, flight, or recruitment by Hollis.

events.title: Sam: Last Call
events.trigger: Sam relationship and drinking level high.
events.what_happens: Sam refuses to serve you and tells you why.
events.branches: get angry, take the cab home, or ask for help.
events.consequences: the drinking track turns or deepens; Sam's late-game test.

events.title: Confession
events.trigger: faith-compatible character, after a critical incident.
events.what_happens: Father Tomás hears your confession, including what you can't tell anyone else. He also knows the families of the missing.
events.branches: confess fully, partly, or walk out.
events.consequences: moral injury relief; a link to the missing thread.

events.title: The Bottle
events.trigger: alcohol or pill dependence crosses the crisis threshold.
events.what_happens: you show up to roll call impaired, or wake up with your gun not where you left it.
events.branches: admit it to Whitlow or Moss, hide it, or get a sick day.
events.consequences: treatment arc, a disciplinary arc, or a disaster on the next hot call.

events.title: Easter Sunday Quake
events.trigger: April 4, 2010 (the real Baja California earthquake felt across LA).
events.what_happens: buildings sway in Rampart; old brick apartments in Pico-Union crack, and people flood the streets thinking a cape fight has started.
events.branches: check on the elderly tenants, manage panicked crowds, or answer the gas-leak calls.
events.consequences: Community reputation; one older building condemned, and Restora bids on it.

events.title: May Day
events.what_happens: the immigrant rights march through MacArthur Park, on the anniversary of the 2007 clash between police and marchers there. Command is nervous; residents remember.
events.branches: crowd posture (gear up, stand back, or walk with the march), handling a provocateur.
events.consequences: Tension and Trust in MacArthur Park for months.

events.title: Lakers Night
events.what_happens: celebrations around the Downtown arena turn into vandalism and fires; Rampart units go on mutual aid.
events.branches: make arrests, hold the line, or protect a vendor's truck.
events.consequences: overtime pay; Fatigue; a use-of-force review if you go hands-on.

events.title: June Gloom Rain
events.trigger: first rain of the year, random.
events.what_happens: oil on the roads, crash after crash, a car in the Hollywood Freeway trench.
events.branches: triage crash scenes in order.
events.consequences: a long, grim shift; a traffic fatality report.

events.title: Fourth of July
events.what_happens: fireworks and celebratory gunfire all night. Veterans roll trauma checks repeatedly; shots-fired calls are nearly impossible to tell apart.
events.branches: take every call, ask for a desk night (FTO judges you), or push through.
events.consequences: the worst trigger night of the year; possible misperception episode.

events.title: The Erasure Anniversary
events.what_happens: the anniversary of Meridian's destruction of a Japanese city in 1945. Anti-super protests in Silver Lake; Japanese-American families hold vigils in Little Tokyo; cape networks run tributes.
events.branches: protest detail posture.
events.consequences: Tension; sets up SW-07.

events.title: Ledger Rankings Night
events.what_happens: new Ledger rankings air on every TV in The Precinct. Solstice climbs; the squad bets.
events.branches: bet, react, or leave.
events.consequences: a recurring mood beat; in Act 2 you can compare ranking jumps to fight dates (fight_pattern support).

events.title: The Heat Wave
events.trigger: late September (the record heat of September 27, 2010).
events.what_happens: triple-digit heat; tempers, domestics, heatstroke, a child in a hot car (SC-02).
events.branches: manage your own Fatigue; choose which calls to prioritize.
events.consequences: the busiest shift block of the year.

events.title: Santa Ana Smoke
events.what_happens: fires in the hills; ash on Rampart's cars; evacuees in shelters; a looter in an evacuated neighborhood.
events.branches: mutual aid choices.
events.consequences: overtime; respiratory penalty for a shift.

events.title: Solstice's Biopic Premiere
events.what_happens: mutual aid at the premiere. Solstice walks the carpet with Héctor's widow protesting across the street.
events.branches: crowd control, protect the protesters, or get a moment with Solstice.
events.consequences: Media; Castellan attention; a clue if you overhear a staffer.

events.title: Halloween
events.what_happens: half of Echo Park is dressed as heroes; a kid in a Breakwater costume gets beaten up by fans.
events.branches: who you arrest.
events.consequences: a light-to-dark tonal beat; Media.

events.title: Día de los Muertos
events.what_happens: altars across Pico-Union and Westlake, including one for Héctor and one for the missing from the Hole.
events.branches: visit off duty, leave something, or keep walking.
events.consequences: Community Trust; the families of the missing talk to you if you came.

events.title: Thanksgiving Shift
events.what_happens: you're working; your family eats without you. The station potluck; a domestic call at a house set for twenty.
events.branches: call home during Code 7 or not.
events.consequences: family Strain; squad bonding.

events.title: Christmas Eve
events.what_happens: loneliness calls, a robbery at a toy store, an old man who calls 911 just to talk.
events.branches: stay with him or clear the call.
events.consequences: Composure restore or a missed hot call.

events.title: New Year's Eve
events.what_happens: celebratory gunfire; a falling bullet wounds a child on a rooftop in Pico-Union.
events.branches: find the shooter, give first aid, or calm the crowd.
events.consequences: a critical incident; community anger toward the gang it blames.

events.title: The Overpass
events.what_happens: a man stands on the Hollywood Freeway overpass rail. A cape network van is already filming.
events.branches: talk him down (De-escalation), wait for SWAT negotiators, or go hands-on.
events.consequences: life saved or lost; trauma; Media.

events.title: The Hot Car
events.what_happens: a toddler locked in a car outside a Westlake swap meet.
events.branches: break the window now, find the owner, or wait for fire. Time is everything.
events.consequences: child lives or dies; arrest of the parent or not.

events.title: The Gentle Giant
events.what_happens: a laundromat worker manifests Tier 2 strength mid-shift and can't stop breaking things; he's terrified. Agents are 20 minutes out.
events.branches: calm him, Taser him, or get him out before the agents arrive.
events.consequences: he registers, he's taken (another missing), or he runs; links to MS-16.

events.title: Abuela's Gun
events.what_happens: an elderly woman holds a revolver on a burglar in her kitchen; the burglar is her grandson.
events.branches: who you disarm first; whether you arrest him.
events.consequences: family outcome; a revolver that shouldn't exist.

events.title: The Dead Man's Phone
events.what_happens: the victim's phone keeps ringing. The screen says "Mamá."
events.branches: answer, let it ring, or hand it to the detectives.
events.consequences: trauma; a later death notification (SC-15) if you answer.

events.title: The Taco Truck
events.what_happens: an armed robbery at your truck while you're eating, out of uniform shirt.
events.branches: draw, de-escalate, or let it go and follow.
events.consequences: the owner's loyalty; crossfire risk.

events.title: Downed Hero
events.what_happens: a low-ranked hero crashes through an apartment roof in Pico-Union. The family below is dead. He's hurt and begs you not to write it the way it happened.
events.branches: help him, write it straight, or call his handler.
events.consequences: a Ledger attribution case; Castellan or a rival PR firm comes calling.

events.title: The Lake
events.what_happens: a body in Echo Park Lake among the lotus beds. It's a Restora surveyor.
events.branches: scene management; who you call first.
events.consequences: a clue to the conspiracy's internal tensions.

events.title: The Fake Cop
events.what_happens: residents tell you about a "cop" extorting undocumented families. He's an ex-security guard with a costume badge, and Calloway knows him.
events.branches: sting, arrest, or follow the money.
events.consequences: community trust; a link to Calloway.

events.title: The Hoarder
events.what_happens: a welfare check on a hoarder's apartment turns into a fire.
events.branches: go in, wait, or pull out the neighbors.
events.consequences: smoke injury; a rescued or lost life.

events.title: The Quinceañera
events.what_happens: a quinceañera in a rented hall; a rival gang shows up; a fight breaks out in front of the birthday girl.
events.branches: de-escalate, arrest, or wait for backup.
events.consequences: Pico-Union Tension.

events.title: The Planted Bag
events.trigger: skipped_car_check, or Calloway hostility in Act 2.
events.what_happens: a suspect you transported says the drugs found in your back seat aren't his. He's right.
events.branches: book it anyway, admit the gap, or investigate who left it.
events.consequences: Credibility in court; evidence of a setup.

events.title: The Defector at the Desk
events.what_happens: a man walks into Rampart's lobby and asks Peg for asylum in broken English. He's a Soviet merchant sailor off a ship in San Pedro. Agents arrive within an hour.
events.branches: speak his language (bloc-origin bonus), stall the agents, or hand him over.
events.consequences: the agency's interest in you; a Cold War thread.

events.title: The Boosted Kid
events.what_happens: a Spark-boosted teenager lifts the front of a car and won't stop shouting; the Taser fails.
events.branches: wait him out, use the beanbag, or shoot.
events.consequences: one of the hardest use-of-force calls in the game.

events.title: The Notification
events.what_happens: you knock on a door to tell a mother her son is dead.
events.branches: how you say it; whether you stay.
events.consequences: trauma; the family remembers you.

events.title: Officer Needs Help
events.trigger: Act 2, fixed; the officer depends on who is alive and close to you.
events.what_happens: a classmate or squadmate goes down in Pico-Union and the radio goes quiet.
events.branches: how you arrive (Code 3 driving), triage, and whether you chase the shooter.
events.consequences: a death or survival among the cast; a funeral scene.

events.title: The Barricaded Veteran
events.what_happens: a proxy-war veteran barricades in his Pico-Union apartment during a flashback. Your background changes everything: a veteran PC can talk to him in his own language.
events.branches: talk, wait for SWAT, or go in.
events.consequences: he lives or dies; trauma for veteran PCs.

events.title: The Stalker
events.trigger: Halcyon relationship or Silver Lake district.
events.what_happens: an obsessed fan has been living in a hero's garage in Silver Lake.
events.branches: arrest, mental health hold, or warn.
events.consequences: a hero's gratitude or a lawsuit.

events.title: The River
events.what_happens: a pursuit ends in the concrete Los Angeles River channel with a car on its roof.
events.branches: climb down or wait.
events.consequences: the suspect lives or dies; a pursuit review.

events.title: The Lost Boy
events.what_happens: a six-year-old lost at MacArthur Park; his mother speaks only K'iche'.
events.branches: find a translator, search, or call it in.
events.consequences: a pure good call: reunion, Composure restore and Community Trust.

events.title: The Ghost Block
events.what_happens: a night call inside the Hole's oldest ruins; someone has been living in a collapsed building since 1998. He remembers Temple Street.
events.branches: bring him out, talk, or leave him.
events.consequences: a witness to 1998.

events.title: Echo Park Burglar: Opening
events.what_happens: burglaries in newly renovated Victorians; nothing valuable taken, only family photos left behind by previous owners.
events.branches: canvass, stake out, or ask Garza.
events.consequences: the case opens.

events.title: Echo Park Burglar: The Old Tenant
events.what_happens: the burglar is a woman evicted from the house years ago, collecting what's left of her family.
events.branches: arrest, warn, or help her get the photos legally.
events.consequences: Community reputation in Echo Park; a Restora-style eviction pattern.

events.title: Filipinotown Scam: Opening
events.what_happens: elders lose savings to callers posing as Ledger victim-compensation officials.
events.branches: interview victims (Tagalog helps), trace calls.
events.consequences: the case opens.

events.title: Filipinotown Scam: The Office
events.what_happens: the scam runs out of an office that also handles real Castellan compensation claims.
events.branches: raid it, use it, or hand it to Szabo.
events.consequences: a money-thread clue; elders' savings recovered or not.

events.title: Lafayette Park Killing: Opening
events.trigger: Act 2, fixed, or earlier via PL-12.
events.what_happens: a North Korean defector is found dead in Lafayette Park. Federal agents take over within hours.
events.branches: push back, cooperate, or keep your notes.
events.consequences: the case opens; Korean community trust.

events.title: Lafayette Park Killing: The Assassin
events.what_happens: the killer is an Eastern-bloc agent, and the agency let it happen to protect an asset.
events.branches: arrest the agent, trade the information to Hollis, or give it to Rachel.
events.consequences: Federal reputation; Cold War fallout.

events.title: Silver Lake Protests: Opening
events.what_happens: anti-super activists and hero fans clash weekly; the LAPD stands between them.
events.branches: posture and arrests.
events.consequences: the case opens; Tension in Silver Lake.

events.title: Silver Lake Protests: The Provocateur
events.what_happens: one of the most violent "activists" is paid by Castellan to make the movement look dangerous.
events.branches: expose him, arrest him quietly, or use him.
events.consequences: Media; a Castellan clue.

events.title: Pico-Union Arsonist: Opening
events.what_happens: buildings on Restora's purchase list keep burning, at night, empty.
events.branches: stake out, interview, or test burn evidence (Power Assessment).
events.consequences: the case opens.

events.title: Pico-Union Arsonist: The Firestarter
events.what_happens: the arsonist is Beto's older sister, a fire manifester, burning buildings so Restora can't profit and hiding from the agency.
events.branches: arrest her, hide her, or bring her in as a witness.
events.consequences: a witness against the agency or another one taken.

events.title: Runaway in the Hole: Opening
events.what_happens: a Pico-Union family begs you to find their daughter, who ran to the Hole.
events.branches: search alone, ask Lalo, or ask Calloway.
events.consequences: the case opens; the missing-persons thread advances.

events.title: Runaway in the Hole: After the Fight
events.trigger: case board linked, after a fight.
events.what_happens: she was there the night of a fight and hasn't been seen since; a van was seen.
events.branches: tell the family the truth, tell them she ran further, or keep looking.
events.consequences: the family's trust; a direct lead into MS-30.
